title: bittersweet (feat. Luke Chiang)

poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE MOMENTS ARE PERFECTLY LIT BUT TRANSIENT,
poetryFrame.rightVertical: A WHISPERED VOW AGAINST THE INEVITABLE DAWN.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: BITTERSWEET LIGHT WHERE OUR STORIES BEGIN.
sonnetLines: The heart keeps count of passing hours,
Measuring joy against the fading light;
A fragile bloom among forgotten towers,
Held captive by the promise of the night.
We build our worlds on whispered, hopeful air,
Knowing the structure cannot long endure;
This sweet ache that we both choose to share,
Is beautiful, yet bittersweet and pure.
To risk the fall for just one perfect glance,
A dangerous comfort in your steady gaze;
We dance upon the edge of circumstance,
Through golden haze and labyrinthine maze.
So let us stay within this fragile gleam,
And live inside this shared, suspended dream.
